name: Juan Corvinos
title: President, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Leads operations, business development, commercial strategy, and strategic partnerships to drive growth across HE CALA. Deep experience in hotel development, owner relations, and project management.
bio: Previously SVP Development, Architecture, Design & Construction for Hilton in Latin America and the Caribbean—oversaw full development cycle for all Hilton brands, signing 350+ management and franchise agreements and helping grow Hilton’s CALA portfolio from 63 to 280+ open hotels. Senior Leadership Sponsor for Hilton’s Hispanic LatinX ERG; assignments in Malaysia, Barcelona, London, and Washington, D.C.

name: Michael Register
title: Chief Development Officer, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Leads sourcing of new opportunities and owner relations for Hotel Equities CALA. Former Managing Director at Highgate focused on the Caribbean and Latin America; prior partner in Trust Hospitality.
bio: Instrumental in sourcing and negotiating management contracts across CALA. Trust managed hotels across Mexico, DR, Colombia, Brazil, Jamaica, Costa Rica, Panama, Anguilla, Aruba, Curaçao, Bahamas, Turks & Caicos, Trinidad, and St. Lucia. Earlier: Nikki Beach worldwide openings; co-founder of software company AAT; corporate and business law in Brazil and Miami.

name: Marilia Pergola
title: VP of Operations, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Leads operational strategy and execution across HE’s expanding CALA portfolio—revenue management, brand compliance, financial performance, and pre-opening excellence.
bio: Builds strong owner relationships and elevates guest experiences throughout the region. Signals HE’s commitment to an in-market leadership team with tailored support for owners and partners.

name: Martin Larralde
title: VP of Finance, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Oversees financial operations, strategy, and performance management across HE CALA’s hotels—working with ownership and internal teams to optimize asset performance.
bio: 10+ years in hospitality finance: cross-border planning, capital management, and forecasting for full-service and resort properties. Fluent English and Spanish. Finance lead for Hilton All-Inclusive, launching integration of finance systems and technology.

name: Maria del Pilar Garcia
title: Senior Director of IT Systems, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Oversees strategic planning and implementation of technology across HE’s portfolio—IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and system integrations for operational efficiency.
bio: 10+ years in hospitality technology. IT lead for Hilton All-Inclusive and Luxury launches including Opera, per-person pricing, wearables, and related platforms. Keeps HE at the forefront of hospitality technology innovation.

name: Margie Aristy Mai
title: Director of Sales and Marketing, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Leads revenue growth and brand strategy across the Caribbean and Latin America—market positioning, business development, and integrated marketing campaigns.
bio: 10+ years in hospitality sales. Bilingual English and Spanish (learning Italian). Strong grasp of regional market dynamics and a results-driven approach to sales leadership.

name: Rodrigo Cuello
title: Sr. Director of Human Resources, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Leads recruitment, training, employee relations, compensation, benefits, and organizational development for HE CALA—with deep experience in openings and rebranding.
bio: Strong track record hiring executive and large-scale hospitality talent, with multicultural LATAM experience and a psychology background. Bilingual Spanish and English. Focuses on smooth, proper openings and organizational health.

name: Mariana Gonzalez
title: Director - Shared Services and Ops Finance
summary: Leads Hotel Equities’ Shared Services Center (SSC) in Mexico for back-office operations—supporting HE CALA scale with disciplined ops finance.
bio: Previously at Hilton overseeing the Hilton Shared Services Office in Mexico and the Dominican Republic across brands from focused service to 1,000+ key luxury all-inclusive properties. Bilingual Spanish and English.
